questions.question: A person walking with a white cane or guide dog is likely to be:

options.text: A person involved with a traffic study.

questions.explanation: You must always yield to a blind person using a white cane or guide dog.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves sharply to the right ahead.

questions.question: When sharing the road with a truck, it is important to remember that trucks generally:

options.text: Require longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles do.
Require less time to pass on a downgrade than smaller vehicles do.
Require a smaller turning radius than smaller vehicles do.
Require less time to pass on an incline than smaller vehicles do.

questions.correctAnswerText: Require longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles do.
questions.explanation: Trucks are large and heavy. They need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles.

questions.question: When approaching a stop sign that is not marked by a crosswalk, drivers should stop their vehicles before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop at the stop line if there is one. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
Speed up to cross the tracks before the gate is lowered.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Not pay attention to how many tracks there are to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look both ways, listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When approaching a railroad crossing that has no warning signals (such as electric flashing lights or gates), a driver should slow down, look, and listen.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with no warning devices, slow down and look both ways. Listen for a train. Only cross when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that another road crosses ahead. Watch for traffic from other directions.

questions.question: On a freeway, you realize you missed your turn or exit. You should:

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your lane of travel.
Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or other location where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or other location where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, do not back up or stop. Drive to the next exit or safe place to turn around. Backing up on a freeway is illegal.

questions.question: A driver entering public traffic from a driveway or private road:

options.text: Should yield to drivers already on the public road.
May force their way into traffic.
Can assume that other drivers will change lanes to make room.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should yield to drivers already on the public road.
questions.explanation: When entering traffic from a driveway or private road, you must yield to drivers already on the road. Merge safely when it is clear.

questions.question: A professional truck driver must:

options.text: Have a valid commercial driver license.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have a valid commercial driver license.
questions.explanation: A commercial driver license (CDL) lets you operate tractor-trailers, buses, tank vehicles, and vehicles carrying hazardous materials. A regular driver license lets you operate vehicles and small trucks under 26,001 pounds.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: Your license will be revoked or suspended if you:

options.text: Make a false statement to the DMV.
Take a driver license examination for another person.

questions.explanation: The DMV or a court can revoke or suspend your license if you are convicted of crimes including making false statements to the DMV, eluding police, or taking a driver license exam for someone else.

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit when conditions are poor.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing and you do not see or hear a train. You must stop:

options.text: If a stop sign is posted.
If a crossing gate is lowered.
If the crossing lights are flashing.

questions.explanation: Always stop before crossing railroad tracks if flashing red lights are on, a gate is down, a stop sign is posted, or a flagger signals you to stop. If you are unsure whether a train is too close, stop. Never race a train.

questions.question: Orange is the color of signs used to communicate with drivers in construction work zones.
questions.explanation: Most signs in work areas are orange and diamond-shaped. Some are rectangular. These signs are reflective so they stand out at night.

questions.question: In which of the following ways can alcoholic beverages affect you?

options.text: It gives you a feeling of false confidence.

questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time, coordination, and balance. It impairs your judgment and vision, making it harder to judge distance and react to your surroundings.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you to an intersection ahead.

questions.question: Always signal when:

options.text: Pulling into or out of a parking space.
Pulling into traffic from an alley or parking area.

questions.explanation: Always use your turn signal when changing lanes, pulling into or out of a parking space, or pulling into traffic from an alley or parking area. Signaling helps prevent accidents.

questions.question: Your driver license will be suspended or revoked if you are convicted of:

options.text: Driving a vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
Committing a serious crime using a vehicle.

questions.explanation: The DMV or a court can suspend or revoke your driving rights for several offenses. These include driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs, lying to the DMV, and committing a serious crime using a vehicle.

questions.question: When driving on major highways:

options.text: Be ready to react to road hazards.

questions.explanation: It is important to stay alert on highways and be ready to react quickly to unexpected hazards. Keep your eyes moving to avoid highway hypnosis. Do not look at any one thing for more than a few seconds.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, wait until the entire car is visible in your rearview mirror before moving back to the right lane.
questions.explanation: When passing, do not return to the right lane until the entire vehicle you passed is visible in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: Drinking alcohol while taking drugs can:

options.text: Decrease the effects of the drugs and alcohol.
Increase the effects of both the drugs and alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase the effects of both the drugs and alcohol.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol and drugs can increase the effects of both. Driving after consuming alcohol or drugs is unsafe. Combining them is even more dangerous.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: When encountering an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove of their driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If another driver is driving dangerously near you, stay calm and create distance between your vehicles. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: Passing is prohibited:
questions.explanation: It is illegal and unsafe to pass another vehicle on hills, curves, at intersections, and at railroad crossings.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead.

questions.question: A sign of drunk driving is:
questions.explanation: Signs of drunk driving include speeding, weaving, driving slower than traffic, jerky movements, and sudden stops.

questions.question: When getting your driver license, the DMV may test your:
questions.explanation: To get a driver license, you will take a vision test. You may also take a knowledge test and a road skills test. A DMV representative will tell you which tests you need.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, what should you do?

options.text: Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show the driver they are wrong.
Do something aggressive back to get even.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, stay calm and get out of their way. Fighting back makes the situation more dangerous.

questions.question: When should you use turn signals or hand signals?
questions.explanation: Use a turn signal whenever you change lanes, turn, or enter or exit a highway.

questions.question: What is the purpose of highway markings?

options.text: They are only used in construction zones.
They are always red and blue.

questions.explanation: Highway markings give information to drivers. They help you position your vehicle correctly, show where it is safe to pass, and warn you about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: What should you do when an emergency vehicle approaches with flashing red or blue lights?

options.text: Try to reach your destination before the emergency vehicle catches up.
Keep driving but try to stay out of its way.
Pull over to the side of the road and stop completely.
Stop in the middle of an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the side of the road and stop completely.
questions.explanation: You must let all emergency vehicles pass. Pull over to the right edge of the road when you can. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first before pulling over.

questions.question: What type of sign is diamond-shaped?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and usually yellow. Orange diamond signs are used in work areas. These signs warn you about hazards or areas with special rules.
